subject.title: Anthropic rejects when multiple tool_result are split across separate messages

question: Should this ClawHub issue be routed to the OpenClaw runtime/provider tracker, or intentionally kept here as a cross-repo placeholder until the runtime fix is linked?
rationale: The report is concrete and aligned with OpenClaw provider stability, but the affected serializer is not present in the ClawHub repository and the target cleanup policy does not allow closing non-implemented ClawHub issues.

options.title: Route To Runtime Tracker
options.body: Create or link the canonical OpenClaw runtime/provider issue and keep this ClawHub issue open only as needed for cross-repo visibility until that fix is resolved.

options.title: Keep As ClawHub Placeholder
options.body: Leave this issue open in ClawHub with the current needs-maintainer-review state, accepting that it is not directly actionable from this checkout.

options.title: Close After Linked Runtime Fix
options.body: Close this issue only after a concrete OpenClaw runtime commit or release is linked that groups multi-tool Anthropic results correctly.

recommendation.title: Route To Runtime Tracker
recommendation.body: Create or link the canonical OpenClaw runtime/provider issue and keep this ClawHub issue open only as needed for cross-repo visibility until that fix is resolved.
